propositions: Pin health classification incorrectly rejects unchanged related-material pins as stale-pin-drift when their fingerprint was computed under a supported historical generation that differs from the current generation

Related-pin health validation omits the historical full-hash compatibility check already applied to own-ticket attestations via _legacy_material_ok, causing false positives after fingerprint algorithm evolution

A prerequisite pin matching a supported historical fingerprint recomputation of current material should be classified current, not stale, provided no genuine material drift occurred between review and validation

The attestation layer must supply a compatibility predicate to pin_health.derive_health to recognize that a mismatched latest fingerprint does not prove material drift if a supported historical generation exactly reproduces the signed pin
